Breakdown.IsPerturbation.text: The stored transport field includes the time and dilation terms before subtracting the Laplacian. Its Hessian is a weak derivative representative.

Breakdown.ExtendedCertificateData.target.text: The data store pin values for the full profile. Subtracting the approximate pins gives the correction target.

Breakdown.Cert.XX.text: The iteration space contains spatial derivatives but no time-graph condition. Every bordered output supplies that additional condition.

Breakdown.Cert.extendedHeldContractsHold.text: Condition (7.26) controls the supremum part of the difference metric. The paper's simultaneous fixed point leaves that condition unused.

Breakdown.Cert.extendedDataContinuityHol.text: Continuity is obtained through solenoidal test pairings. An arbitrary residual representative need not be continuous in the H norm.

Breakdown.Cert.extendedSupBoundHolds_of.text: Only scalar enstrophy needs the shorter period. The averaging argument does not assume the same time symmetry for the chosen forcing representative.

Breakdown.Cert.readingEnergyHolds_of.text: This reading uses the Frobenius square of the gradient and the trace of a weak Hessian. Its immediate premise is GraphClosedHolds.

Breakdown.extended_certificate_orbit_pro.text: The public conclusion discards the selected parameter and correction. The proposed wrapper is mapped separately because it belongs to the supplied local work.

Breakdown.Cert.HH.text: HH is the time-periodic L2 space of solenoidal Fourier forcing symbols. The paper's H also contains unprojected representatives, so the two spaces must not be identified directly.
